description: Microsoft Graph is Microsoft's unified API for accessing Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, security, and related cloud data and services. It provides a single Graph endpoint and related tooling for user, group, file, communications, device, search, and administrative data.
summary: Microsoft Graph exposes a large OAuth-protected REST API at `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0` across mail, calendar, contacts, files, Teams, directory, security, admin, search, and related workloads, plus an MCP server at `https://graph.microsoft.com/mcp` and a PowerShell CLI.
